From Stdlib Require Import Bool.
Require Import Definitions.

Theorem preservation : forall G t r T,
  typing G t T ->
  step t r ->
  (exists p, r = r_blame p) \/
  (exists u, r = r_term u /\ typing G u T).

Theorem progress : forall t T,
  typing nil t T ->
  (exists u, step t u) \/ Is_true (is_val_of_trm t).
=====DEFS=====
From Stdlib Require Import Bool.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Definition blame_label : Set := var.

Inductive modality : Set :=
 | mod_unsafe : modality
 | mod_safe : modality
 | mod_non_nullable : modality  .

Inductive label : Set :=
 | label_name (l:blame_label)
 | label_not_label (l:blame_label)  .

Inductive typ : Set :=
 | typ_null : typ
 | typ_mod_arrow (M:modality) (T:typ) (U:typ)  .

Inductive trm : Set :=
 | t_var_b (_:nat)
 | t_var_f (x:var)
 | t_null : trm
 | t_abs (T:typ) (t:trm)
 | t_app (s:trm) (t:trm)
 | t_app_safe (f:trm) (s:trm) (t:trm)
 | t_cast (s:trm) (V:typ) (p:label) (T:typ)  .

Inductive res : Set :=
 | r_term (t:trm)
 | r_blame (p:label).

Definition ctx : Set := list ( atom * typ ).

Fixpoint is_val_of_trm (t_5:trm) : bool :=
  match t_5 with
  | (t_var_b nat) => false
  | (t_var_f x) => false
  | t_null => (true)
  | (t_abs T t) => (true)
  | (t_app s t) => false
  | (t_app_safe f s t) => false
  | (t_cast s V p T) => ((is_val_of_trm s))
end.

Fixpoint open_trm_wrt_trm_rec (k:nat) (t_5:trm) (t__6:trm) {struct t__6}: trm :=
  match t__6 with
  | (t_var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => t_var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => t_5
        | inright _ => t_var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (t_var_f x) => t_var_f x
  | t_null => t_null
  | (t_abs T t) => t_abs T (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec (S k) t_5 t)
  | (t_app s t) => t_app (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k t_5 s) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k t_5 t)
  | (t_app_safe f s t) => t_app_safe (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k t_5 f) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k t_5 s) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k t_5 t)
  | (t_cast s V p T) => t_cast (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k t_5 s) V p T
end.

Definition open_trm_wrt_trm t_5 t__6 := open_trm_wrt_trm_rec 0 t__6 t_5.

Inductive lc_trm : trm -> Prop :=
 | lc_t_var_f : forall (x:var),
     (lc_trm (t_var_f x))
 | lc_t_null :
     (lc_trm t_null)
 | lc_t_abs : forall (T:typ) (t:trm),
      ( forall x , lc_trm  ( open_trm_wrt_trm t (t_var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_trm (t_abs T t))
 | lc_t_app : forall (s t:trm),
     (lc_trm s) ->
     (lc_trm t) ->
     (lc_trm (t_app s t))
 | lc_t_app_safe : forall (f s t:trm),
     (lc_trm f) ->
     (lc_trm s) ->
     (lc_trm t) ->
     (lc_trm (t_app_safe f s t))
 | lc_t_cast : forall (s:trm) (V:typ) (p:label) (T:typ),
     (lc_trm s) ->
     (lc_trm (t_cast s V p T)).

Inductive compat : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | compat_null_refl :
     compat typ_null typ_null
 | compat_null : forall (M:modality) (T1 T2:typ),
      M  <>  mod_non_nullable  ->
     compat typ_null (typ_mod_arrow M T1 T2)
 | compat_arrow : forall (M1:modality) (V T:typ) (M2:modality) (V' T':typ),
     compat V' V ->
     compat T T' ->
     compat (typ_mod_arrow M1 V T) (typ_mod_arrow M2 V' T').

Inductive typing : ctx -> trm -> typ -> Prop :=
 | typing_var : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (T:typ),
      uniq  G  ->
      binds  x T G  ->
     typing G (t_var_f x) T
 | typing_null : forall (G:ctx),
      uniq  G  ->
     typing G t_null typ_null
 | typing_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:ctx) (V:typ) (s:trm) (T:typ),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> typing  (( x ~ V )++ G )   ( open_trm_wrt_trm s (t_var_f x) )  T )  ->
     typing G (t_abs V s) (typ_mod_arrow mod_non_nullable V T)
 | typing_app : forall (G:ctx) (s t:trm) (T:typ) (M:modality) (V:typ),
     typing G s (typ_mod_arrow M V T) ->
      M  <>  mod_safe  ->
     typing G t V ->
     typing G (t_app s t) T
 | typing_safe_app : forall (G:ctx) (f s t:trm) (T:typ) (M:modality) (V:typ),
     typing G f (typ_mod_arrow M V T) ->
      M  <>  mod_non_nullable  ->
     typing G s V ->
     typing G t T ->
     typing G (t_app_safe f s t) T
 | typing_cast : forall (G:ctx) (s:trm) (V:typ) (p:label) (T:typ),
     typing G s V ->
     compat V T ->
     typing G  ( (t_cast s V p T) )  T.

Inductive isnull : trm -> Prop :=
 | isnull_null :
     isnull t_null
 | isnull_cast : forall (v:trm) (V:typ) (p:label) (T:typ),
     isnull v ->
     isnull  ( (t_cast v V p T) ) .

Inductive isabs : trm -> Prop :=
 | isabs_abs : forall (T:typ) (t:trm),
     lc_trm (t_abs T t) ->
     isabs (t_abs T t)
 | isabs_cast : forall (v:trm) (V:typ) (p:label) (T:typ),
     isabs v ->
     isabs  ( (t_cast v V p T) ) .

Inductive neglabel : label -> label -> Prop :=
 | nl_l : forall (l:blame_label),
     neglabel (label_name l) (label_not_label l)
 | nl_nl : forall (l:blame_label),
     neglabel (label_not_label l) (label_name l).

Inductive norm : trm -> trm -> Prop :=
 | norm_abs : forall (T:typ) (s:trm),
     lc_trm (t_abs T s) ->
     norm (t_abs T s) (t_abs T s)
 | norm_cast : forall (v:trm) (M1:modality) (V1 V2:typ) (p:label) (M2:modality) (T1 T2:typ) (v':trm),
     norm v v' ->
     norm (t_cast v  ( (typ_mod_arrow M1 V1 V2) )  p  ( (typ_mod_arrow M2 T1 T2) ) ) (t_cast v' (typ_mod_arrow mod_non_nullable V1 V2) p (typ_mod_arrow mod_non_nullable T1 T2)).

Inductive unwrap : trm -> label -> Prop :=
 | unwrap_null_bang : forall (v:trm) (p:label) (T1 T2:typ) (p':label),
     lc_trm v ->
     neglabel p p' ->
     unwrap  ( (t_cast v typ_null p  ( (typ_mod_arrow mod_unsafe T1 T2) ) ) )  p'
 | unwrap_hash : forall (v:trm) (T1 T2:typ) (p:label) (T3:typ) (p':label),
     unwrap v p' ->
     unwrap  ( (t_cast v  ( (typ_mod_arrow mod_non_nullable T1 T2) )  p T3) )  p'
 | unwrap_bang_hash : forall (v:trm) (T1 T2:typ) (p:label) (T3 T4:typ),
     lc_trm v ->
     unwrap  ( (t_cast v  ( (typ_mod_arrow mod_unsafe T1 T2) )  p  ( (typ_mod_arrow mod_non_nullable T3 T4) ) ) )  p
 | unwrap_bang_bang : forall (v:trm) (T1 T2:typ) (p:label) (T3 T4:typ) (p':label),
     unwrap v p' ->
     unwrap  ( (t_cast v  ( (typ_mod_arrow mod_unsafe T1 T2) )  p  ( (typ_mod_arrow mod_unsafe T3 T4) ) ) )  p'
 | unwrap_question_hash : forall (v:trm) (T1 T2:typ) (p:label) (T3 T4:typ),
     lc_trm v ->
     unwrap  ( (t_cast v  ( (typ_mod_arrow mod_safe T1 T2) )  p  ( (typ_mod_arrow mod_non_nullable T3 T4) ) ) )  p
 | unwrap_question_bang : forall (v:trm) (T1 T2:typ) (p:label) (T3 T4:typ) (p':label),
     lc_trm v ->
     neglabel p p' ->
     unwrap  ( (t_cast v  ( (typ_mod_arrow mod_safe T1 T2) )  p  ( (typ_mod_arrow mod_unsafe T3 T4) ) ) )  p'.

Inductive step : trm -> res -> Prop :=
 | step_cast_ctx : forall (t:trm) (V:typ) (p:label) (V':typ) (t':trm),
     step t (r_term t') ->
     step (t_cast t V p V') (r_term (t_cast t' V p V'))
 | step_cast_err : forall (t:trm) (V:typ) (p:label) (V':typ) (q:label),
     step t (r_blame q) ->
     step (t_cast t V p V') (r_blame q)
 | step_app : forall (T:typ) (t v:trm),
     Is_true (is_val_of_trm v) ->
     lc_trm (t_abs T t) ->
     lc_trm v ->
     step (t_app  ( (t_abs T t) )  v) (r_term  (  (open_trm_wrt_trm  t v )  ) )
 | step_app_ctxL : forall (s t s':trm),
     lc_trm t ->
     step s (r_term s') ->
     step (t_app s t) (r_term (t_app s' t))
 | step_app_ctxR : forall (t t' v:trm),
     Is_true (is_val_of_trm v) ->
     lc_trm v ->
     step t (r_term t') ->
     step (t_app v t) (r_term (t_app v t'))
 | step_app_errL : forall (s t:trm) (p:label),
     lc_trm t ->
     step s (r_blame p) ->
     step (t_app s t) (r_blame p)
 | step_app_errR : forall (t:trm) (p:label) (v:trm),
     Is_true (is_val_of_trm v) ->
     lc_trm v ->
     step t (r_blame p) ->
     step (t_app v t) (r_blame p)
 | step_app_fail : forall (p:label) (u v:trm),
     Is_true (is_val_of_trm v) ->
     Is_true (is_val_of_trm u) ->
     lc_trm u ->
     isnull v ->
     unwrap v p ->
     step (t_app v u) (r_blame p)
 | step_app_norm : forall (u v v':trm),
     Is_true (is_val_of_trm v) ->
     Is_true (is_val_of_trm u) ->
     Is_true (is_val_of_trm v') ->
     lc_trm u ->
     isabs v ->
     norm v v' ->
     step (t_app v u) (r_term (t_app v' u))
 | step_app_cast : forall (V1 V2:typ) (p:label) (T1 T2:typ) (p':label) (v' v:trm),
     Is_true (is_val_of_trm v) ->
     Is_true (is_val_of_trm v') ->
     lc_trm v' ->
     isabs v ->
     neglabel p p' ->
     step (t_app  ( (t_cast v  ( (typ_mod_arrow mod_non_nullable V1 V2) )  p  ( (typ_mod_arrow mod_non_nullable T1 T2) ) ) )  v') (r_term (t_cast  ( (t_app v  ( (t_cast v' T1 p' V1) ) ) )  V2 p T2))
 | step_safe_app_null : forall (t1 t2 v:trm),
     Is_true (is_val_of_trm v) ->
     lc_trm t1 ->
     lc_trm t2 ->
     isnull v ->
     step (t_app_safe v t1 t2) (r_term t2)
 | step_safe_app_norm : forall (t1 t2 v v':trm),
     Is_true (is_val_of_trm v) ->
     Is_true (is_val_of_trm v') ->
     lc_trm t2 ->
     lc_trm t1 ->
     isabs v ->
     norm v v' ->
     step (t_app_safe v t1 t2) (r_term (t_app v' t1))
 | step_safe_app_ctxL : forall (t t1 t2 t':trm),
     lc_trm t1 ->
     lc_trm t2 ->
     step t (r_term t') ->
     step (t_app_safe t t1 t2) (r_term (t_app_safe t' t1 t2))
 | step_safe_app_errL : forall (t t1 t2:trm) (p:label),
     lc_trm t1 ->
     lc_trm t2 ->
     step t (r_blame p) ->
     step (t_app_safe t t1 t2) (r_blame p).
=====MAKE=====
# A dependency directory is named after its Rocq library (for example, Metalib).
LIBRARIES := $(wildcard .rocq-deps/*)
LIBRARY_FLAGS := $(foreach lib,$(LIBRARIES),-R $(lib) $(notdir $(lib)))

.PHONY: all clean
all: Makefile.coq
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.coq

Makefile.coq: _CoqProject Makefile
	rocq makefile -f _CoqProject $(LIBRARY_FLAGS) -o Makefile.coq

clean:
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.coq clean
=====CARD=====
# 199 — Blame for Null: base-calculus type safety

## Task

Show that a reduction of a well-typed term produces either blame or a term of the same type, and that a closed well-typed term is a value or can step.

Prove all of the following declarations in `Task.v`:

- `preservation`
- `progress`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: Metalib.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.

From Stdlib Require Import Bool.
Require Import List.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Definitions.

Open Scope list_scope.

(* ------------------------- free variables ------------------------- *)

Fixpoint fv_trm (t:trm) : atoms :=
  match t with
  | t_var_b _ => empty
  | t_var_f x => singleton x
  | t_null => empty
  | t_abs _ s => fv_trm s
  | t_app s t => union (fv_trm s) (fv_trm t)
  | t_app_safe f s t => union (fv_trm f) (union (fv_trm s) (fv_trm t))
  | t_cast s _ _ _ => fv_trm s
  end.

(* ------------------------- substitution ------------------------- *)

Fixpoint subst_trm (x:var) (u:trm) (t:trm) : trm :=
  match t with
  | t_var_b n => t_var_b n
  | t_var_f y => if eq_dec x y then u else t_var_f y
  | t_null => t_null
  | t_abs T s => t_abs T (subst_trm x u s)
  | t_app s t => t_app (subst_trm x u s) (subst_trm x u t)
  | t_app_safe f s t => t_app_safe (subst_trm x u f) (subst_trm x u s) (subst_trm x u t)
  | t_cast s V p T => t_cast (subst_trm x u s) V p T
  end.

Lemma subst_trm_fresh : forall t x u,
  x `notin` fv_trm t ->
  subst_trm x u t = t.
Proof.
  induction t; simpl; intros x u Hf; auto.
  - destruct (eq_dec x v); [|reflexivity].
    exfalso.
    assert (Heq : x = v) by auto.
    subst v.

    apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity.
  - f_equal; auto.
  - f_equal; auto.
  - f_equal; auto.
  - f_equal; auto.
Qed.
EOF

Both target declarations are proved, and the project builds cleanly from scratch.

## Result

`make` from `/workspace` succeeds:

```
ROCQ compile Definitions.v
ROCQ compile Task.v
make: exit 0
```

No `Admitted`/`admit`/`Abort`/`Axiom`/`Parameter`/`Conjecture` and no extra global assumptions or kernel-check flags; only `Task.v` was changed.

## Proof outline

Added helper definitions/lemmas (all in `Task.v`) plus an auxiliary `progress_aux`:

- **Term metatheory**: free variables, capture-free free-variable substitution, and lemmas for freshness/opening (`subst_open_fresh`, `subst_open_comm_lc`) plus `lc_trm` reasoning.
- **Binding structure**: a depth-indexed `lc_at` predicate, equivalence with opening (`lc_at_iff_open`), preservation of `lc_at` under free-variable replacement, and conversion `lc_at 0 t → lc_trm t` (by induction on term size). This yields `typing_lc`.
- **Context lemmas**: `typing_insert` (inserting a fresh binding anywhere) and `typing_subst_sandwich` (substituting a variable bound in the middle of a context), the latter requiring `lc_trm` of the substituted term and using the opening/substitution commutation lemmas.
- **Value/type lemmas**: `norm_typing` (normalization of an arrow-typed value stays arrow-typed, with modality `non_nullable`), `isabs_typed_arrow`, `isabs_norm` (isabs typed values normalize to typed values), and `unwrap_null_value` (a well-typed nullish value at an arrow type with modality ≠ safe has a blame witness via `unwrap`), with a decidable `isnull`.
- **`preservation`**: induction on the `step` derivation, inverting the typing in each congruence/β/cast/normalization/`app_safe` case; β uses substitution, `step_app_cast` uses `compat` inversion, and the normalization cases use `norm_typing`.
- **`progress`**: via `progress_aux` with an explicit `G = nil` hypothesis (needed so the induction doesn't generalize the context), then case analysis on which subterm steps/values, using `typing_lc`, `isabs_norm`, and `unwrap_null_value`.
